questions.q: What does it mean to "compile" a model with TensorRT-LLM?
options: Converting the model's source code into a different programming language
Producing an ahead-of-time, GPU-specific optimized executable ("engine") from the trained model, instead of running it through a general-purpose framework step by step
Retraining the model from scratch on new data
Removing all of the model's layers to make it smaller
questions.explain: Compiling with TensorRT-LLM produces a GPU-specific, ahead-of-time-optimized engine, trading flexibility for faster execution compared to running the model through a general-purpose framework like PyTorch.

questions.q: What is "kernel fusion," one of TensorRT-LLM's key optimizations?
options: Combining multiple small GPU operations into fewer, larger ones to reduce kernel-launch overhead
Merging two different models into a single set of weights
Running the model simultaneously on CPU and GPU
Increasing the model's context length limit
questions.explain: Kernel fusion combines multiple separate GPU operations into fewer, larger ones, reducing the overhead from launching many small GPU kernels back to back.

questions.q: What does TensorRT-LLM call its continuous-batching-style technique?
options: Dynamic queuing
In-flight batching
Paged scheduling
Static admission
questions.explain: TensorRT-LLM's term for letting new requests join a running batch without waiting for the whole batch to finish is "in-flight batching."

questions.q: What is the main limitation of using TensorRT-LLM by itself, without pairing it with another tool?
options: It cannot run on NVIDIA GPUs
It is not, on its own, a full networked server with an HTTP API, request queuing across replicas, or multi-model hosting
It cannot support quantization
It only works with models under 1 billion parameters
questions.explain: TensorRT-LLM is a library for building and running optimized inference engines; it is typically paired with Triton Inference Server, which provides the networked, production-facing service layer.

questions.q: What does the trtllm-build command do in the TensorRT-LLM workflow?
options: It downloads the original model weights from the internet
It compiles a converted checkpoint into a runnable, GPU-specific engine, baking in batch size, precision, and kernel choices
It starts the HTTP server for client requests
It deletes the KV cache
questions.explain: trtllm-build is the compilation step: it takes a converted checkpoint and produces the optimized engine, with decisions about batch size, precision, and GPU-specific kernels baked in at build time.
